shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure carved in low relief on a vertical slab/monument
elaborate headdress with banded/segmented elements above the head
body ornament worn on the chest (pectoral)
arms with hands rendered in relief
incised curvilinear/wavy lines along a lower band
justification: Both surfaces depict a single dominant anthropomorphic figure carved in low relief on an upright slab, wearing an elaborate multi-part headdress at the top and a distinct chest ornament, with incised curvilinear lines forming a band toward the base. The biggest difference is the orientation and pose: A shows a seated figure in strict profile with a clearly modelled face, hand and arm, while B presents a frontal, symmetrical, largely faceless composition whose body is covered with abstract emblematic motifs (a rosette-like disc, paired ovals) rather than naturalistic anatomy.
